items.title: Irreducible components pull back to unions of irreducible components under a field extension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For an extension of fields K/k and a scheme X over k, the inverse image of an irreducible component of X under the projection X_K to X is shown to be a union of irreducible components of X_K (statement lines 1595-1601). The proof works with generic points: flatness of T_K to T lets generalizations lift, so a point of T_K generic in an irreducible component of T_K maps to the generic point of T (proof lines 1604-1608); the decisive step is that any specialization of such a point inside X_K must stay in T_K, because nothing specializes to the generic point of T inside X (proof lines 1608-1611). The claim is H2: one standard flatness property plus a specialization argument, but the specialization step is the part that cannot be read off formally.
